system.description: If a hostile creature moves within 20 feet of you, you can spend your Reaction and 4 Star Chakra to force all creatures within 20 feet of you to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they are overwhelmed by the radiating potency of your chakra, having their movement reduced to 0 until the end of the current turn and they gain 2 rank of Weakened and are Bruised.
